name: Titan Wind Energy (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd
summary: Established in 2005 and headquartered in Taicang, China, Titan Wind Energy (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd manufactures and supplies wind turbine towers and related components within the country. The company's operations also extend to the production and sale of wind power blades and their molds. Beyond manufacturing, it actively participates in the complete process of wind farm projects, including their development, investment, construction, and operational management. Additionally, the firm engages in equity investments, offers finance leasing, and conducts general import and export trade.
